result.instructions: Tools for Attio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are in our sales pipeline and what stage is each one in?"; "Find the company record for Acme and show its open tasks."; "Add a note to Ada Lovelace's record summarising today's call.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Attio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run attio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run attio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run attio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. attio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: attio_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected key
tools.description: Show which Attio token is connected: whether it is active, its scope and its token type. Attio API: GET /v2/self.

tools.name: attio_list_objects
tools.title: List objects
tools.description: List the objects in the workspace (for example people, companies, deals) with their slugs and ids. Call this first to learn the object slugs. Attio API: GET /v2/objects.

tools.name: attio_get_object
tools.title: Get an object
tools.description: Get one object by slug or id, with its api_slug and display name. Attio API: GET /v2/objects/{object}.

object.description: Object slug (for example `people`, `companies`, `deals`) or object id.

tools.name: attio_list_attributes
tools.title: List attributes
tools.description: List the attributes (fields) of an object or a list, with their api_slug and type. Use the api_slug as the key in record values. Attio API: GET /v2/{objects|lists}/{identifier}/attributes.

target.description: Whether the identifier is an object or a list.

identifier.description: Object slug or id, or list slug or id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_list_workspace_members
tools.title: List workspace members
tools.description: List the workspace members (staff who use Attio), with their ids and names. Attio API: GET /v2/workspace_members.

tools.name: attio_query_records
tools.title: Query records
tools.description: List or filter records of an object (for example people or companies), with sorts and paging. Read only; uses a POST body for the filter. Attio API: POST /v2/objects/{object}/records/query.

object.description: Object slug (for example `people`, `companies`, `deals`) or object id.

filter.description: Attio filter object, for example { "name": "Ada" }. See the Attio filtering guide. Do not combine with filter_view_id.

filter_view_id.description: Id of a saved view to apply instead of a filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Get one record of an object by id, with its attribute values. Attio API: GET /v2/objects/{object}/records/{record_id}.

object.description: Object slug (for example `people`, `companies`, `deals`) or object id.

tools.name: attio_search_records
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search records across the workspace by text. Optionally limit the search to some object slugs. Read only. Attio API: POST /v2/objects/records/search.

objects.description: Object slugs to search, for example ["people", "companies"].

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the workspace lists (pipelines and other list views) with their slugs and ids. Attio API: GET /v2/lists.

tools.name: attio_query_list_entries
tools.title: Query list entries
tools.description: List or filter the entries of a list (for example a sales pipeline), with sorts and paging. Read only. Attio API: POST /v2/lists/{list}/entries/query.

filter.description: Attio filter object, for example { "name": "Ada" }. See the Attio filtering guide. Do not combine with filter_view_id.

filter_view_id.description: Id of a saved list view to apply instead of a filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally only those attached to one record (give parent_object and parent_record_id). Read only. Attio API: GET /v2/notes.

parent_object.description: Object slug of the record the notes are attached to.

parent_record_id.description: Record id the notes are attached to.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally filtered by completion, assignee or linked record. Read only. Attio API: GET /v2/tasks.

assignee.description: Workspace member id of the assignee.

linked_object.description: Object slug of a linked record.

sort.description: Sort order, as the Attio API defines it (for example created_at:desc).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: attio_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: Create a record in an object (for example a person or a company) from attribute values. Changes CRM data. Attio API: POST /v2/objects/{object}/records.

object.description: Object slug (for example `people`, `companies`, `deals`) or object id.

values.description: Attribute values keyed by attribute api_slug (or attribute_id). Single-select takes a value; multi-select takes an array.

tools.name: attio_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: Update attribute values of one record. Multi-select values are appended, not replaced. Changes CRM data. Attio API: PATCH /v2/objects/{object}/records/{record_id}.

object.description: Object slug (for example `people`, `companies`, `deals`) or object id.

values.description: Attribute values keyed by attribute api_slug (or attribute_id). Single-select takes a value; multi-select takes an array.

tools.name: attio_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: Attach a new note to one record. Changes CRM data. Attio API: POST /v2/notes.

parent_object.description: Object slug of the record to attach the note to.

parent_record_id.description: Id of the record to attach the note to.

content.description: Note content, in the chosen format. Use \n for line breaks.

tools.name: attio_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a plain-text task linked to one or more records. Changes CRM data. Attio API: POST /v2/tasks.

content.description: Task text (plain text, up to 2000 characters).

deadline_at.description: Deadline as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or null for none.

linked_records.description: Records the task is linked to.

assignees.description: Workspace members assigned to the task.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Attio
prompts.description: What you can do with Attio here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_sales_pipeline_and_the_stage_of_each_deal
prompts.title: Review the sales pipeline and the stage of each deal
prompts.description: List the lists of the workspace, such as a sales pipeline. Query its entries to see the stage of each deal.

prompts.name: find_a_company_and_its_open_tasks
prompts.title: Find a company and its open tasks
prompts.description: Search records across the workspace by text. Then list the tasks, filtered to that record, to see what is still open.

prompts.name: read_the_notes_on_a_record_before_a_call
prompts.title: Read the notes on a record before a call
prompts.description: Read one record with its attribute values. List the notes attached to that record.

prompts.name: log_the_summary_of_a_call_as_a_note
prompts.title: Log the summary of a call as a note
prompts.description: Attach a new note with the summary to one record. The note changes CRM data.

prompts.name: add_a_person_and_a_follow_up_task
prompts.title: Add a person and a follow-up task
prompts.description: Create a person record from its attribute values. Then create a task linked to that record. Both calls change CRM data.
